card: SS-2026-11-W1-01 · reel_quote_broll (one generated live-action shot plus a code end card), tier O15 (10 to 20 s) · job reach · belief B1 ('your ads aren't failing, your enquiries are dying after the click'; this post is the unaware entry: a quiet phone is not a bad month but a business that waits for the next referral) · awareness unaware · cta_type send (send to a partner or friend) · hook_type contrarian · voiced narrator, AI label on.
facts:
- The owner's own words: 'telefoni nuk bie' (the phone doesn't ring).
- The owner's situation: he gets clients from referrals and Instagram, but not predictably; he wants clients every month, not by luck.
- 'The season' is the owner's assumed excuse, not a fact.
- No numbers or counts are allowed in this reel.
hook:
Visual 0-3 s: an open shop at midday in daylight, staff blurred in the back; at the owner's desk a hand lifts the phone in a deep red case and gives it one short shake, as if broken; the screen stays empty (no notifications, no numbers). Hands only.
Text hook (top third, 0-3 s): 'Telefoni s'bie? / S'është prishur. As sezoni.' [Phone not ringing? It isn't broken. Nor is the season.]
Spoken L1 (fixed): see line 1.
structure: ST6 myth vs truth, compact (one-line reframe), second-person narrator. O15 rungs: recognition (L1), the reframe (L2), the payoff 'therefore' that closes the hook's question and mirrors 'As sezoni' (L3), CTA send to a partner (L4) that loops to the hook's 'season' with a light moment.
actq: Would you send this reel to someone (a partner or a friend who owns a business)?
end_card: Ivory card, the CTA as the hero in large type: 'Dërgoja ortakut, kur të thotë "është sezoni".' The StraightScale wordmark small at the bottom. Held 18.7 to 19.3 s.

lines.sq: Telefoni nuk bie, por s'është prishur, dhe as sezoni s'e ka fajin. Po klienti yt i fundit, nga erdhi?
lines.en: The phone doesn't ring, but it isn't broken, and the season isn't to blame either. But your last client, where did they come from?
lines.super: 0-3 s text hook 'Telefoni s'bie? / S'është prishur. As sezoni.'; from 3.0 s 'Klienti yt i fundit: nga erdhi?'
lines.visual: One continuous H3 shot (0 to 15 s), hands only. 0-1.5 s the short shake. 1.5-5 s the hand sets the phone face up on the desk; a thumb wakes the screen: empty. 5-8.3 s the hand slides the phone a little aside and rests by it.

lines.sq: Nga një rekomandim? Atëherë biznesi yt rri e pret tjetrin.
lines.en: From a referral? Then your business sits and waits for the next one.
lines.super: 'Nga një rekomandim?' then 'Biznesi yt rri e pret tjetrin.' [From a referral? / Your business sits and waits for the next one.]
lines.visual: Same shot, slow push in: the hand beside the dark phone drums once, then stops. Waiting.

lines.en: So it isn't the season. It's the waiting.
lines.super: 'S'është sezoni. Është pritja.' [It isn't the season. It's the waiting.]
lines.visual: The hand rests still beside the dark phone; the shop door behind in soft focus, nobody coming in. Hold to the end of the shot (15 s).

lines.sq: Dërgoja ortakut, kur të thotë "është sezoni".
lines.en: Send it to your partner, when he tells you "it's the season".
